tool.name: impg stats

param.label: List sequence names and lengths
param.help: Skip overlap statistics and instead print one line per sequence with its name and length.

param.label: Unidirectional interpretation
param.help: Disable bidirectional alignment interpretation. By default every A->B alignment creates an implicit B->A reverse mapping.

param.label: Trace spacing
param.help: Trace spacing for .1aln/.tpa alignment files (used when converting tracepoints to CIGAR). Ignored for plain PAF.

tool.help:
**impg stats** — summarize pairwise alignments
Prints overview statistics for one or more PAF/1ALN/TPA alignment files: the number of query+target sequences, total sequence length, number of overlaps, per-sequence overlap counts, and bridge-genome coverage.
With **List sequence names and lengths** the tool instead emits one line per sequence (name and length), skipping the overlap statistics — useful for sanity-checking the alignment index before running `impg query` or `impg partition`.
-----
**Input**
- One or more PAF files (optionally bgzipped). The tool builds a reusable index first, then summarizes it.
**Output**
- A plain-text statistics report.
